name: hehehe
description: Codex-first AI development workflow with Claude as an independent reviewer.

interface.longDescription: hehehe is a Codex-first AI development workflow. Codex owns planning, implementation, fixes, and final decisions, while Claude is used as an independent secondary reviewer for evaluation, challenge review, and security checks when available.
defaultPrompt: Use $hehehe:full-resolve to build this feature end to end.
Use $hehehe:frontend-architecture to build frontend features with FSD and Tailwind.
Use $hehehe:backend-architecture to design or review backend boundaries and data access.
Use $hehehe:observability to verify local runtime evidence and structured backend errors.
Use $hehehe:repository-knowledge to initialize, synchronize, and verify project knowledge.
Use $hehehe:maintain-codebase to audit drift and prepare one focused maintenance change.
Use $hehehe:pr-loop to repair CI and review feedback until the pull request reaches its authorized terminal state.
Use $hehehe:subagent-resolve to resolve and implement a ready task with parallel Codex sub-agents.
Use $hehehe:doctor to diagnose the plugin and project setup.
Use $hehehe:resume to continue the active workflow run.
